meta.schema: chart (club pages, verbatim) | out/doubtful/questionable (official report) | announced_replacements (dated official news only) | actually_played (game-day source only)
meta.rule: replacements are names announced by a dated official source, never inferred; actually_played stays blank without a game-day source; not-listed never means available
meta.coverage: Week 10, 32 teams; chart layer 5/32 clubs (F-D1); actually_played 0/32 (DR-31)

snapshot_gap: Two dated captures exist now (the brief's 'one capture' finding predates the 2026-11-16 recount). The designations series needs >= 5 captures per club-week (Wed-kickoff daily) before deltas can be replayed; blocked on gate F-T1 (NFL terms section 1.3).

depth_conflicts_stale_rows.note: Players listed as 1st string on a club depth chart who carry an Out/Doubtful game status on the official NFL Week 10 injury report (https://www.nfl.com/injuries/league/2026/reg10). This is the concrete demonstration that club depth charts lag the official injury report.
